focus_intro.message: Pomodoro sessions block your focus list during work intervals and open it during breaks. You get a notification at each change, and the countdown shows on the toolbar badge.

focus_end_locked.message: A Hard Lock is active, so this session cannot end early.

focus_end_challenge.message: Your commitment level is Challenge, so sessions cannot end early.

focus_end_body.message: Your focus list will open again right away.

focus_work_note.message: Your focus list is blocked until this interval ends.

focus_break_note.message: Break: your focus list is open until this interval ends.

focus_empty_list.message: Your focus list is empty, so nothing will be blocked. Add sites below first.

focus_list_intro.message: Sites blocked only during work intervals. One per line: a domain (reddit.com) or a path (youtube.com/shorts). Start a line with = for an exact URL.

focus_other_rules.message: Other rules active only during focus

focus_other_hint.message: Edit these on the Rules page.

focus_cfg_saved.message: Focus settings saved. They apply to the next session.

focus_cfg_hint.message: Changes apply to the next session, not the one running now.

lock_active_hint.message: You can extend a lock or add to it, but not end, shorten or loosen it.

lock_start_intro.message: A Hard Lock blocks sites for a fixed time and cannot be cancelled. Use it for deep work or deadline days.

lock_sched_intro.message: Start a Hard Lock automatically on chosen days, for example weekdays 09:00 for 2 hours.

lock_honest_title.message: What a Hard Lock can and cannot do

lock_honest_body.message: No extension can stop itself from being disabled or removed on chrome://extensions. FocusGuard does not pretend otherwise. What it does: the lock survives browser restarts, extension reloads and updates, and re-applies as soon as Chrome or the extension starts again.

settings_commit_intro.message: How hard should it be to loosen your own rules? Tightening rules never needs a check.

settings_perm_title.message: Permissions and why they are needed

blockpage_intro.message: The block page shows why a site is blocked and when it opens again. Add your own message and image to make it yours.

blockpage_redirect_hint.message: Want to land somewhere useful instead? Create a Redirect rule on the Rules page.
